title: [C20T4] - How bamboo fabric is made
prompt: The diagram below shows how fabric is manufactured from bamboo. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagram illustrates the manufacturing process of bamboo fabric.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the production of bamboo fabric involves nine distinct stages, beginning with the cultivation of bamboo plants in spring and culminating in the creation of woven fabric. In addition, the process combines both agricultural and industrial techniques, requiring several months to complete from plantation to final product.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: The manufacturing process commences with planting bamboo plants during the spring season. After a growing period, the mature bamboo is harvested in autumn, when the plants have reached their optimal size. The harvested bamboo is then cut into strips using specialized cutting equipment, before being crushed to create a liquid pulp. This pulp undergoes a filtering process to separate the long fibres from the liquid component.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: The subsequent stages focus on refining and processing the extracted fibres. Water and amine oxide are added to soften the fibres, making them suitable for textile production. The softened fibres are then spun to create yarn, which serves as the raw material for fabric production. Finally, the yarn is woven together to form the finished bamboo fabric, completing the manufacturing cycle.
